Stars Compare Tool

2027 Medicare Star Ratings (measurement year 2025) vs 2026: local peers, national percentiles, and member-weighted state and county maps.
Maps: County and state shapes from US Census cartographic boundaries (us-atlas); Puerto Rico is not drawn. Member counts by county come from CMS monthly MA enrollment by state/county/contract (cells of 10 or fewer suppressed). Heat map averages assign each contract's single published rate to every area where its members live, weighted by those members or unweighted.
Privacy: anonymous usage counts (pages, contracts and measures viewed) via GoatCounter; no cookies and no personal data.
Sources: CMS 2026 and 2027 Star Ratings data tables (measure data, measure stars, summary ratings), 2027 contract enrollment, CMS monthly MA enrollment by state/county/contract, and the October 2026 contract service area by county file (used for local peers). Local CCP contracts only.
